headline: Fireworks AI discloses second breach exposing Notion customers' chat transcripts
summary: Fireworks AI disclosed a new security breach, its second in as many months, after attackers accessed its development machines by breaching a third-party cloud provider. The breach exposed AI chat transcripts belonging to Notion customers, affecting a small number of workspaces, according to Notion.
